title: monoon hypogaeum
intro: Monoon hypogaeum, commonly known as the Borneo ironwood, is a plant species belonging to the family Annonaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin diseases. The health benefits of Monoon hypogaeum include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions in reducing pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
